+plugins {
+    id("application")
+}
+
+def jarsPath = layout.projectDirectory.dir("../../../build/sdk/lib")
+
+dependencies {
+    compileOnly files(
+            jarsPath.file("javafx.base.jar"),
+            jarsPath.file("javafx.graphics.jar"),
+            jarsPath.file("javafx.controls.jar"),
+            jarsPath.file("javafx.swing.jar")
+    )
+}
+
+java {
+    toolchain.languageVersion.set(JavaLanguageVersion.of(25))
+}
+
+application {
+    mainClass = "app.LightingApplication"
+    applicationDefaultJvmArgs = [
+        "--module-path", jarsPath.getAsFile().absolutePath,
+        "--add-modules", "javafx.controls,javafx.swing",
+        // unblock the default 60fps cap
+        "-Dprism.vsync=false",
+        "-Djavafx.animation.pulse=1000"
+    ]
+}
